$comment: Every number in a tool body or tool FAQ, and what it rests on. Checked by scripts/audit_claims.py: an unregistered number fails CI; an entry whose status is not 'verified' is a launch-checklist item. 'cited-not-fetched' means the citation is specific but was written without reaching the source from this environment.

statuses.verified: computed, engine-tested or taken from this repository's datasets
statuses.cited-not-fetched: a specific statute or primary source is named; open it and confirm before launch
statuses.needs-verification: a published statistic; confirm the figure against the named source before launch

claims.means: The worked-example salary used across the site

Among verified states on a $95,000 salary: state tax runs from $0 (Texas, Florida, Tennessee) to $4,648.40 (Virginia), 4.9% of gross; New York's is $4,564.75, 4.8% of gross; take-home runs from $75,662.50 to $70,656.15 (New York, after $441.60 of PFL and disability contributions), a $5,006.35 gap, 5.3% of gross; Pennsylvania $72,679.50
